zh.title: 美國航空規劃在致命地震十週後復航卡拉卡斯
zh.summary: 美國航空規劃分階段復航卡拉卡斯；機場將啟用臨時國際登機門
body: 根據Simple Flying於2026年8月29日的報導，美國航空已規劃重新恢復飛往卡拉卡斯（Caracas）的航班。此一回歸時程安排在當地遭遇致命地震災害的10週之後。隨著卡拉卡斯的重新開放，當地機場將啟用臨時國際登機門，以協助客運服務的重建。
美國航空針對此次卡拉卡斯復航規劃了分階段恢復計劃。該航空公司預計將混合使用寬體客機與區域客機來執行這些排定航班。透過設置臨時登機門與分階段恢復航班，將能逐步重建當地的國際航空聯絡。

en.title: American Airlines Schedules Caracas Return 10 Weeks After Deadly Earthquakes
en.summary: American Airlines plans a Caracas return; flights will resume with temporary gates
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying on August 29, 2026, American Airlines has scheduled its return to Caracas. This decision comes ten weeks after the region was impacted by deadly earthquakes. The reopening of Caracas features the establishment of temporary international gates to support the resumption of air services.

American Airlines is preparing for a phased return of flights to Caracas. The airline plans to operate these scheduled flights using a mixed fleet of widebody and regional aircraft. These temporary gates and phased operations will facilitate the gradual return of flights to the area.

zh.title: 俄羅斯交運第三批Su-35S戰機
zh.summary: 俄羅斯航太軍獲新批次Su-35S；數量未公布
body: 聯合航空製造公司（UAC）於2026年8月27日宣布，已向俄羅斯航太軍交付一批新型Su-35S多用途戰鬥機，但未說明該批次包含多少架飛機。
根據發布的聲明，這些戰鬥機完成了完整的工廠測試週期，並由國防部飛行員在多種操作模式下進行飛行，隨後從阿穆爾河畔共青城轉移至其作戰基地。
UAC未透露接收部隊身分、基地名稱或交付數量。發布的影像顯示至少兩架飛機。俄羅斯國家技術集團（Rostec）先前於2026年4月17日和5月26日宣布類似的Su-35S交接，但均未指明數量。

en.title: Russia delivers third Su-35S fighter batch of 2026, UAC says
en.summary: UAC confirms new Su-35S batch for Russian forces; number undisclosed
body: The United Aircraft Corporation (UAC) said on August 27, 2026, that it had delivered a batch of new Su-35S multirole fighters to the Russian Aerospace Forces, without saying how many aircraft the batch contained.

The fighters completed a full cycle of factory testing and were flown in a range of operating modes by Ministry of Defense pilots before ferrying from Komsomolsk-on-Amur to their operational base, according to the release. UAC did not identify the receiving unit, did not name the base, and gave no delivery figure. Imagery published with the announcement shows at least two aircraft.
Rostec announced comparable Su-35S handovers on April 17, 2026, and May 26, 2026, also without specifying quantities.
